codeReview.summary: Commit a7c52dc successfully migrated Topbar and Sidebar styling to Tailwind and added focused component tests, but it only delivered part of the fh-dashboard-layout contract. The reviewed implementation still lacks the required mobile/tablet sidebar collapse behavior and leaves key dashboard layout surfaces on legacy CSS classes instead of a fully Tailwind-based layout.

issues.description: The sidebar remains a static desktop aside in this commit. There is no mobile/tablet collapse state, hamburger toggle, or overlay, so the required responsive navigation behavior for narrow viewports is not implemented.

The dashboard shell was not fully migrated to Tailwind. The page still renders legacy CSS hooks like `appShell`, `appMain`, and `flash`, so the monolithic layout/CSS dependency remains instead of the requested all-Tailwind dashboard layout.
The workspace selector exposes the `reference` view with the label `API` instead of the feature's requested `Reference`, so the visible workspace naming does not match the specification.

summary: Reviewed handoff 1d667f1a-26eb-4092-adee-219ff861d140 and commit a7c52dc.
